author: GitHub
description:
Meet Ori and Josh, the creators behind the new remote control feature for GitHub Copilot. In this short, they explain how you can start a coding session on your computer and seamlessly continue it on your phone. See how easy it is to manage multiple agent sessions at once without being tied to your desk. Download the GitHub mobile app to try remote control today and take your code on the go.
